title: One restoration test item (one line per JSONL record)

age_set.description: true only for Pallava + Uttiramerur (>1,100 years old)

split.description: assigned BY INSCRIPTION, never by line

left.description: ISO-15919 text before the gap (same line, plus previous line if short)

hard.description: true if no near-identical parallel for target exists in TRAIN

kind.description: blank = <gap> with no expert fill (discovery set, no target scoring)

source_url.description: https://dharmalekha.info/texts/<id> or GitHub blob URL at pinned commit
